messages:
fix: make applyPatch conform to RFC 6902 for move onto itself and non-JSON input

A move whose from equals its path now requires from to exist; the document,
value members and operations must be JSON values, so nothing is silently
altered and every failure is a JsonPatchError.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
